profiles.base: Normal input/motion; actual screenshot and native/crop readability review
profiles.keyboard-resize-rotate: Same page/dialog/session; reduce height by min(300,45% height), type and Tab/wheel, restore and swap dimensions; retain trace and before/during/after captures
profiles.zoom-200: Actual browser zoom200%; record resulting CSS viewport/device scale; not a screenshot resize
profiles.motion-normal: Retain and actually watch complete source/Resting/return/refill transition plus settled endpoint
profiles.motion-reduced: No perception of animation required; ordered named movement facts and same final state
profiles.exit-reenter: Use actual Exit and reenter without hidden state mutation; record both screens.
profiles.keyboard-only: Real Tab/Enter/Escape; no pointer rescue or forced clicks.
profiles.reload: Resume the saved tutorial step without duplicate action; retain before/after trace.
profiles.touch-hold-scroll: Touch-equivalent tap/hold/native scroll; first and last cards reachable.
